text:
jess: Quick flag — I found a bunch of sample-app docs that show putting the API key directly into the request header. example: `fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_KEY' } })`. That encourages copy/paste secrets.

sam: ack. which samples? I can grep.

jess: samples/node-chat/, samples/python-quickstart/, and the HTML widget example. All came from an older curl conversion. Python shows `os.environ['API_KEY'] = '...'` in one place which is worse.

mike: Oof. We should prefer recommending env var usage and the SDK client helper that auto-injects auth. e.g. show `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` instead of manual headers.

elaine: also mention retry/default timeout config. People often copy the snippet and then hammer the API without setting sensible retry/backoff. Small blurb like: "SDKs handle retries by default — configure via client.options.retries".

sam: I can whip up a grep script to find literal tokens and old import names (`import Redwood from 'redwood'`). Want to forbid `YOUR_KEY` or `API_KEY` hardcoded strings in docs output.

jess: +1. I'm going to open a docs PR to replace inline headers with the env/SKD pattern and normalize the env var name to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere.

mike: We should also update the docs template generator so future sample apps don't regurgitate the inline header. I'll take the templates in infra/docs-templates.

elaine: tiny style nit — use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` (no underscores like RW_KEY) and call out how to set it in macOS/linux and Windows (powershell). Keep both Node and Python consistent.

sam: Could we add a quick CI lint job that fails if any docs file contains `YOUR_KEY` or `INSERT_KEY_HERE`? Preferable to run as part of docs build.

jess: I'll add a docs-ci job `no-secret-snippets` that greps and fails. Also adding an automated test that renders the sample readouts and ensures no literal tokens remain.

doc-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — branch: fix/samples-auth-cleanup. Preview build: https://deploy.preview/512

mike: Nice. Assign the templates update to me. ETA EOD.

elaine: After PR merges, we should send a short note to #announcements reminding contributors to use the SDK client examples, not manual header copy.

sam: One more: update the TypeScript example to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` (old import breaks new SDK names). I fixed one instance in the branch.

jess: Thanks — I'll link the PRs in the change log. Also adding a short section in CONTRIBUTING.md about "Example hygiene" (no secrets, prefer env vars, prefer SDK constructors).

doc-bot: docs CI run: all checks passed on fix/samples-auth-cleanup. 10 files changed.

sam: Great work team. After merge I'll run the grep script across other repos (widget, examples) and open follow-ups if anything else pops up. :thumbsup!
